entry_text.dec:d_all_eighteen_shape: {"date": "2026-11-26", "id": "d_all_eighteen_shape", "kind": "call", "speaker": "agent", "delegated": "evidence-for-ask", "run": "rm-role-designer-1795763300", "source": ["OWNER:1795761534460592124", "OWNER:1795755622961436106", "OWNER:1795749543738184808", "src/RimMandrake/WreckedMachines/Patches/WreckedMachines_HideDonorSmelter.xml", "src/RimMandrake/WreckedMachines/Source/WreckedMachinesMod.cs", "design/concepts/WreckedMachines/turn_04.md"], "what": "What 'All 18 machines' means in 0.1.0. Measured 2026-11-26 from the factory mod's defs (workshop folder 3686924415, 1.6): the 18 are the autofarmer, drill platform, smelter, biofuel refinery, masonry saw, mincer, conveyor oven, assembler, neutroamine synthesizer, ammunition press, autoloom, alloy forge, distillery, medicine granulator, machining bay, conveyor crematorium, fish farm (its def loads with Odyssey) and cannery (its def loads only with Vanilla Cooking Expanded; without it the count is 17). Masses run from 35 to 115 kg; every one has a minified form; none carries a trade tag or a reward tag (thingSetMakerTags); all carry the thing category VFEFactory_FactoryCategory, and whether any trader's stock reads that category is UNMEASURED. The Designer's calls, each the obvious consequence and each shown to him in turn_04.md section 1: (1) each of the 18 leaves the build menu the way the built patch takes the smelter out (the def and its recipes stay); (2) the parts that are not production machines stay buildable: the conveyor, the two underground conveyor ends and the hopper (opened by VFE_BasicFactories), the booster and the heatsink (opened by VFE_ComplexFactories); (3) a machine that already stands in an old save is not changed; (4) Mod Settings carry one on/off line per machine, on as shipped, the built donor-smelter switch made general; (5) no trader, quest or map gives a working factory machine, with a check at stage 3; (6) each machine has two research projects (d_study_before_each_repair), so the 18 bring 36; (7) the build takes the smelter first and then the machines in the order the campaign needs (s_utinni_service_first); (8) what each machine does at Kludged and at Refurbished is its onboarding table, build work under one rule that the design writes: Kludged is a part of the machine's work, Refurbished is all of it and slower than the Original. The size he accepted on the card: 136 new pictures of big machines and 17 onboardings by hand. The cannery's checks need Vanilla Cooking Expanded on the mod's small list; stage 3 names that."}

A wreck that is taken apart gives none (the card offered that source and his words leave it out); no trader sells one and no bench makes one. 'Via plot' is read as the campaign's story: this mod has no plot and knows no setting (s_standalone_no_setting), and the component is a plain item, so a layer above can hand one out in its story without this mod knowing. That is the Designer's reading, not his words; turn_04.md section 3 says so and says that a quest inside this mod would be a different build. What follows: a colony with no ruin on its map and no journey reaches Kludged and stops; and 20 machines each cost one component for the last repair (the 18, the power cell, the emanator) while Cold Storage's stasis lockers and the campaign's stasis casket and vaults charge components too, so each component is a choice and a machine that stays Kludged for good is normal play. How rare a component is, is a tuning number for Mod Settings, never a bar."}
entry_text.dec:d_feasible_study_in_vanilla: {"date": "2026-11-26", "id": "d_feasible_study_in_vanilla", "kind": "finding", "source": ["src/RimMandrake/WreckedMachines/Defs/Specials/SpecialResearchOpportunities_WreckedMachines.xml"], "speaker": "agent", "what": "Feasibility, read from the game source through RimSage: the base game has a study mechanism that needs no other mod. A thing with CompProperties_CompAnalyzableUnlockResearch (canStudyInPlace, analysisRequiredRange, showProgress, progress and completion letters) is studied where it stands by JobDriver_StudyItem; a ResearchProjectDef that lists the thing in requiredAnalyzed stays locked until the study count is met, and the research screen says what is not yet studied. Progress is kept by analysisID in the game's AnalysisManager, so it outlives the wreck. Biotech's mechanitor chips use it on items; no vanilla building uses it, so one live look on a building is owed before a bar leans on it. It differs from Research Reinvented's Analyse: vanilla study opens a locked project, Research Reinvented's study fills the project's bar."}

(1) A hauler is built, in the Property mod (src/RimMandrake/RimProperty, the RimMandrake tier): a pawn whose race carries the marker TheftHaulerExtension may uninstall a building of any faction and carry it off; FindMod-guarded patches put the marker on five Droidworks chassis (the Muckraker and four labour and mining droids). (2) That job refuses a building whose def is not Minifiable, and the built smelter wreck has no minified form ('No minifiedDef: a wreck is not haulable and cannot be uninstalled'), so today no pawn, a hauler droid included, lifts the built smelter wreck; the cell and emanator wrecks have a minified form and a colonist lifts them. (3) The lift list of 2026-11-01 classes a wrecked machine WRECKED_TIER, 'minify | droid only', 'a colonist still may not move it'; the pass that applies the list is not built: the tag prefix RM_Lift_ is in no def and no mod source under src/, only in src/RimMandrake/Utils/selftest_salvage_lift_policy.py. (4) No machine that a colonist rides in and that moves a building was found; search scope: src/RimStarWars/Droidworks Defs, Source and Patches for ride, piloted, lifter, loader. (5) Droidworks is mandrake.rsw.droidworks, a RimStarWars mod that needs Humanoid Alien Races and calls itself a 'Private campaign mod'; this mod stands alone at the RimMandrake tier (s_standalone_no_setting), so it cannot require Droidworks. (6) The factory mod's smelter is 3 by 4 cells with Mass 60, and the base game gives a pawn a caravan capacity of 35 kg times body size (MassUtility.Capacity, read through RimSage). Feasible in every option of a_who_moves_a_wreck: the wreck needs a minified form in each, and who may order the uninstall is a rule on top (the lift list's own method: give the def a minifiedDef and refuse the colonist's Uninstall)."}

entry_text.dec:d_first_look_read: {"date": "2026-11-27", "id": "d_first_look_read", "kind": "finding", "speaker": "agent", "delegated": "evidence-for-ask", "run": "rm-role-designer-1795769705", "source": ["ITEM:RIMMANDRAKE_STAGE_WRECKED_MACHINES_FIRST_LOOK_ONLY_ONE_BUILD_EVER_PLAYED", "infrastructure/state/ledger/events/BENCH.jsonl", "OWNER:1795760440829904733", "design/concepts/WreckedMachines/look_01.md", "src/RimMandrake/WreckedMachines/Defs/Specials/SpecialResearchOpportunities_WreckedMachines.xml", "src/RimMandrake/WreckedMachines/Defs/ThingDefs_Buildings/Buildings_WreckedMachines_AutomatedSmelter.xml"], "what": "What the first look at the built mod measured, and what each reading does to the design. The look is the agent's walk of 2026-11-26 on ArchSmall, on the mod's small list (run rm-detached-bench-rimmandrake-stage-wrecked-machines-first-1795761734; keeper save WRECKED_MACHINES_FIRST_LOOK_2026_11_26; the Conductor's note of findings for the Designer is event 1795766557136982102 in the BENCH shard). The Conductor sent him 9 of the 18 captures at 12:00 AM PST 2026-11-27; no word of his about them is on the ledger yet. (1) Levels by eye. The smelter's Wrecked and Kludged levels have their own pictures and read clearly. Refurbished and the original grade share one picture. The power cell and the emanator are one base-game picture in three shades, and the three emanators are hard to tell apart at play zoom. This confirms d_three_looks and adds one thing: a darker shade of one picture does not tell two levels apart, so each Wrecked and each Kludged level needs a picture of its own. (2) A repair reads as a new build. The player picks the Kludged smelter in the Factory build tab and places it on the wreck; a colonist takes the wreck apart, then builds a grey frame on the empty ground. The design answers with d_repair_is_made_on_the_machine. (3) Study. With Research Reinvented loaded, a colonist cannot study a wreck without a field research kit; the player must order each session, and the researcher never chose the wreck himself. One session of about 6 game hours moved the restoration project from 10 to 223 of 2000 points. Later the wreck offered no study; the worker's guess (about 60 per cent) is that the wreck's study was used up, and nobody checked. That study is Research Reinvented's. The study that 0.1.0 leans on is the base game's (d_study_before_each_repair, d_feasible_study_in_vanilla), and nobody has seen the base game's study on a building in play: that look is still owed before a bar leans on it. What the reading adds to the design, as lines for stage 3: study of a machine needs no item of another mod; the player turns study on once on the machine, and colonists who do research come back to it by themselves; the machine shows how far its study is. (4) Moving. The smelter wreck has no Uninstall and cannot be carried; the power-cell wreck has Uninstall even when nobody owns it, and a colonist carried it to a stockpile. This confirms the change of d_wreck_is_carried and d_lift_is_data. (5) Faults of the built mod, which the build takes: a no-power mark shows on the Refurbished smelter while its inspect text reads powered, and the Conductor sees the same mark on the Refurbished emanator (c_bolt_on_powered_machine); the wrecked smelter (30 steel) and the original grade are in the Factory build menu."}

entry_text.dec:d_wreck_stands_on_any_ground: {"date": "2026-11-27", "id": "d_wreck_stands_on_any_ground", "kind": "call", "speaker": "agent", "delegated": "evidence-for-ask", "run": "rm-role-designer-1795773471", "source": ["CONDUCTOR:1795774540053514047", "OWNER:1795762605668672773", "OWNER:1795755622961436106", "src/RimMandrake/WreckedMachines/Defs/ThingDefs_Buildings/Buildings_WreckedMachines_AutomatedSmelter.xml", "design/concepts/WreckedMachines/sheet.md", "design/concepts/WreckedMachines/scenes.json"], "what": "A wreck can be set down on any ground that carries a heavy building. A working level needs the ground that the donor machine needs: for the factory machines, the factory mod's own floor. A repair order on a wreck that stands on other ground is unavailable and says so. The factory floor stays in the build menu behind the factory mod's own research, like the other parts (rule R_ground of tree.json). Measured 2026-11-27 from the factory mod's defs (workshop folder 3686924415, 1.6): 14 machines in Buildings_Factories.xml carry terrainAffordanceNeeded FactoryFloor; the terrain VFEF_FactoryFloor is opened by VFE_BasicFactories (after Machining) and is in the factory mod's build category. The built smelter wreck also needs that floor today ('map authoring must lay VFEF_FactoryFloor under every wreck'); the build changes the wreck, not the working levels. Why: his card says that colonists carry a wreck home, and his statement says 'retrieved to a safe location'; a wreck that can stand only on a floor that needs research could not be set down by a colony that has just found it. Read on 2026-11-27 by run rm-role-designer-1795776308 from the game's source through RimSage (GenConstruct.CanPlaceBlueprintOver) and from the factory mod's Terrain_Floors.xml, and not yet seen in play: the game accepts a floor under a standing building only when the building names no ground need or the new floor gives that need, and the factory floor gives one kind of ground only (FactoryFloor). So the wreck's def names no ground need of the base game's kind; a wreck that named Heavy ground could neither get factory floor laid under it nor be installed on factory floor. Both ways must work, and the scene sc_repair_needs_ground reads both in play: the floor laid under a wreck where it stands, and a wreck carried onto factory floor. The Designer's call, not his words; shown to him on sheet.md; he can undo it."}

entry_text.sheet:: # Wrecked Machines, Design Version 0.1.0: the sheet This page is the short view of the design. The complete text of each bar, with its pictures and its test, is in tree.json. The record of every question and answer is record.json and log.md. An agent wrote the bars from your words; each line under "does" names the bar that carries it. You can change any word. Two words used below. An ancient machine is a machine that this mod has made ancient: each production machine of Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory, the vanometric power cell and the psychic emanator, while its line in Mod Settings is on. A level is one of Wrecked, Kludged, Refurbished and Original.
entry_text.sheet:calls that an agent made, which yo: ## calls that an agent made, which you can undo Each call is the Designer's and is logged for your daily digest. None is your words. - From turn 5, shown to you on turn_05.md: a repair is ordered and made on the machine, and a cancelled repair never costs the colony the machine. While a machine's line is on, the world hands out no working one, the base game's vanometric power cell and psychic emanator included. Gravlite sits with plasteel on the Refurbished forge. - New in this stage. A wreck can be set down on any firm ground. A working level needs the ground that the factory mod's machine needs, which is the factory floor. So a repair order on a wreck that stands on other ground is unavailable and says so. The colony then lays the factory floor under the wreck where it stands, or carries the wreck onto such a floor. The factory floor stays in the build menu behind the factory mod's own research. Measured from the factory mod's files: 14 of its machines in the main file need that floor, and the floor is opened by the research Basic Factories. - New in this stage. An order to uninstall a machine that is under repair cancels the repair first: the materials are given back and the machine is carried at its old level. - New in this stage. The first showcase, the mod's face, is the smelter's road home: a wrecked smelter found in a ruin, carried home, studied, made Kludged, studied again and made Refurbished with a component. Nothing was found against it: the smelter is the one machine with pictures of its own today, and the build takes it first. - "Via plot" is read as the campaign's story. This mod has no plot; the component is a plain item that a mod above this one can hand out.
entry_text.sheet:does: ## does - [leaf:only_by_repair] A player cannot research and build an ancient machine, and nothing in the world gives the colony a working one: the colony gets a working one only when its colonists repair a wreck. - [leaf:wreck_is_found] A player meets wrecked machines in the world: they lie in the rooms of ancient ruins, and now and then one lies half-buried on an ordinary map when the colony arrives. - [leaf:wreck_comes_home] Colonists can take up any wreck, carry it away and set it down where the colony wants it. - [leaf:study_opens_research] Colonists study the machine itself, and only that study opens the research for its next repair. - [leaf:repair_on_the_machine] A player orders a repair on the machine, colonists bring the materials and work at it where it stands, and the machine stays in sight at its old level until the work is complete. - [leaf:levels_of_function] A Wrecked machine does no work, a Kludged machine does a small part of the machine's work, a Refurbished machine does all of it, and no repaired machine does it as well as the Original. - [leaf:last_repair_needs_component] The repair to Refurbished needs an Ancient Component, and a colony gets one only by finding it in an ancient ruin. - [leaf:levels_told_apart] At play zoom a player tells a Wrecked machine, a Kludged machine and a whole machine apart by eye, and what the picture shows agrees with what the machine's text says. - [leaf:switch_gives_machine_back] In Mod Settings a player switches any one ancient machine off, and that machine is then the ordinary machine that it was without this mod. - [leaf:no_setting_named] A player reads no name or mark of any story setting in this mod: no ship, no faction and no god. - [leaf:wrecks_join_lines] Pipes and conduit that run to a wreck draw into it as they draw into the same machine at its repaired levels, with no gap. - [leaf:whole_journey] With every ancient machine on and nothing done by a command, a colony finds a wreck, brings it home, studies it, repairs it to Kludged and uses it, then studies it again and repairs it to Refurbished with an Ancient Component from a ruin, and at each step the player can tell what the machine needs next.
entry_text.sheet:does not: ## does not - It does not leave a relic's value out of colony wealth. That is on the list for the next version. - It has no turret, no ship part and no holy repair. The Utinni layer is a separate design after this one. - It does not move the salvage rule or the water distillation machine. Both work as built until they move to their own homes, and no bar of 0.1.0 judges them. - It has no quest that leads to a wreck or rewards a component. - It does not onboard a machine by a program. Onboarding is by hand in 0.1.0, in your words.
entry_text.sheet:his words: ## his words - 2026-11-26, 9:00 PM PST, typed (OWNER:1795755622961436106): "The mod changes specified furniture-installable machines such as Vanilla Factory Enhanced into advanced, ancient machines that can no longer simply be researched and built like normal. Each repair requires machine study, research bench time, and considerable resources. The final refurbishment requires a rare ancient component. While the concept may be applied to any game tree, the mod's initial version will only support Vanilla Factory Enhanced in this fashion." - The same event: "This is the original intention of this mod and remains true. No word of yours about them is on the ledger. A word from you reopens the design.
entry_text.sheet:what it costs: ## what it costs - Pictures. Each of the 18 factory machines needs 8 new pictures (Wrecked and Kludged, four facings); the smelter has its 8. The power cell and the emanator each need a Wrecked and a Kludged picture of their own, and the Ancient Component needs one. An art judge reads each against the canon library. - Research screen. Two restoration projects for each of 20 machines: 40 projects, on one tab of their own. - A stranger's game. With the mod at shipped settings, the factory mod's production machines leave the build menu, and the base game no longer hands out a working vanometric power cell or psychic emanator. One line in Mod Settings gives any one machine back. - A colony that finds no Ancient Component stops at Kludged. With this mod and the factory mod alone, a Kludged alloy forge makes obsidian and nothing else. - Onboarding is by hand: 19 more machines after the smelter, each with its table of what every level makes.
entry_text.sheet:what it is: ## what it is Wrecked Machines changes specified machines that install like furniture, such as those of Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory, into advanced, ancient machines. A colony can no longer simply research and build one. A colony must find one and bring it to a safe place. Colonists study the machine, and the study opens its research. Then they repair the machine slowly, through levels of function. A Wrecked machine does not work. A Kludged machine works at a minimum. A Refurbished machine has full function, but is slower than the original. The Original is a fourth level, there only for comparison: no research and no repair reaches it. Each repair needs study of the machine, time at a research bench and considerable resources. The last repair, to Refurbished, also needs a rare Ancient Component. The idea can be applied to any game tree. This first version supports only Vanilla Furniture Expanded - Factory in this way, and some versions of vanilla expanded items such as archotech power supplies and psychic emitters. That paragraph is your statement, rephrased as you allowed. It is the root of the design (root.md).
